world.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original premium wilderness wolf game environment, cinematic wide landscape about 2:1, 2048 pixels wide if possible.
Primary request: a majestic silver-gray wolf standing on an ancient sandstone outcrop at the FAR RIGHT, overlooking a breathtaking moonlit American Southwest canyon and pine wilderness. Huge luminous full moon behind the far-right wolf, distant indigo mesas, layers of mist in deep canyons, subtle amber light on weathered sandstone. Original beautifully painted natural scene, no commercial artwork.
Composition: left and middle 70 percent is calm low-contrast midnight-indigo canyon, softly detailed pines and mist, reserved for a large reel board overlay. Atmospheric depth and genuine scenery, not gradient. The wolf occupies rightmost 25 percent, full head and pointed ears visible with generous top margin, proud alert three-quarter stance facing slightly left, luxurious realistic silver-gray fur illuminated by cold moon rim light, warm intelligent amber eyes, closed mouth. Wolf looks powerful and dignified, not snarling. Body and paws visible on rock at lower right as composition allows, no head crop. The main moon sits behind wolf at upper right, not in board region. Small foreground grasses on edge only.
Style: exceptional hand-painted 2.5D cinematic game concept art, realistic animal anatomy and tactile fur, sophisticated natural materials, silver-blue moonlight against antique gold/amber sandstone, deep indigo/purple shadows, subtle teal atmosphere. Painterly depth, mature tranquil grandeur, restrained warm highlights, no thick outlines or plastic cartoon style.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, slot machine, board, grid, reels, tribal symbols or appropriated regalia. No copied provider character. Landscape environment art only.
